wavetable_oscillator.notes: OSC A/B/C local RIFF WAVE frames render with pitch, level, pan, absolute/random phase, position, unison and detune. Control-thread FFT mipmaps and cubic interpolation reduce ordinary table aliasing. A typed dual-warp subset now renders Bend/Asym/PWM/Flip, selected nonlinear shapes, and audio-rate FM/RM/AM from main oscillators, SUB or NOISE through a 2x 63-tap FIR path. Many warp IDs, phase-memory modes, advanced unison and higher oversampling remain unsupported.

sub.notes: Native SUB sine source renders and has enable/level controls. Other Serum SUB shapes/phase/pitch semantics are not implemented; no real active-SUB preset test yet.

noise.notes: Native white-noise generator and local WAV/FLAC sample-backed NOISE playback render; imported slot 3 reference decoded off the audio thread by JUCE. A private noise-only derivative of the supplied 2.0.24 preset produced nonzero REAPER realtime peaks. Stereo, pitch/one-shot/color and other Serum NOISE semantics are not implemented.

filters.notes: Filter 1 uses a ZYG trapezoidal state-variable low-pass with editable cutoff, resonance, drive and wet mix. Serum filter type identities remain preserved but are not semantically reproduced; Filter 2 is not rendered. Cutoff smoothing and finite-response tests exist, but full stability/performance sweeps remain open.

routing.notes: OSC A/B/C targets Filter 1, Main, Direct or None and these targets are editable. Dual-filter balance and FX sends are retained but not rendered.

envelopes.notes: Env 1 ADSHR and three native attack/decay/release curve bends render and are tested. Env 2-4, tempo sync, trigger/legato modes and exact Serum curve transfer remain unsupported.

lfo.notes: Native sine LFO 1 plus imported free-running Lorenz, Rossler and random sample-and-hold types render per voice. The supplied 2.0.24 preset executes its original Lorenz LFO 1 to OSC A wavetable-position route. Tempo-synced, Path/custom, mode/direction/phase/rise/delay/smooth semantics remain preserved but unsupported.

matrix.notes: All populated imported rows remain typed and visible. Supported LFOs and Macro 1-8 execute for OSC A WT position, dual-warp depth, or Filter 1 cutoff. The 2.0.24 fixture verifies imported Lorenz-to-WT-position and Macro 1-to-FM-depth routes. Other sources/destinations, aux, curves and slew remain preserved but unsupported; the current UI editor does not yet offer warp destinations.

macros.notes: Eight macro values map to normalized native controls; four are visible at once in the first editor. Macro sources 1-8 execute only for OSC A WT position and Filter 1 cutoff destinations. Other imported macro routes remain preserved without DSP.

vst3_host.notes: Installed VST3 tested in separate REAPER instance with realtime MIDI, armed monitored track, nonzero track/master peaks at 48 kHz. PipeWire default sink monitor captured C4 tone after 12 s of silence (261.47 Hz FFT peak). INIT project save/reopen and editor instantiation were verified. User-edited Serum state reload, automation and other sample rates remain unverified.

clap_host.notes: Pinned clap-juce-extensions builds CLAP. Installed CLAP was inserted in REAPER with realtime MIDI item on armed monitored track; nonzero track/master peaks measured. Real Serum preset import and project reload in CLAP are not yet validated.

native_zyg_preset.notes: v2 JSON and VST3/CLAP host state retain typed patch, matrix, FX identities, LFO/macro/clip raw state, diagnostics and opaque Serum provenance. Local assets are references and reloaded; portable path handling and UI save/reopen host validation remain incomplete.

wavetable_warp.notes: Importer reads observed kParamWarpMenu/Menu2 fields and maps a bounded native subset. Dual phase maps and dual amplitude operations each process in slot order; mixed phase/amplitude order is provisional. Audio-rate source sampling is independent of oscillator render order. The 2.0.24 fixture uses kFM_OSC with a zero-level OSC B source and macro-modulated depth. OSC/OSC2 source ordering is an inference pending oracle verification. PD, FMX/FMP, Self PD, Sync, Remap, filter-source modulation, numerous distortion IDs and 4x/8x modes remain unsupported.
